summary: Tested the Segnalatori change: commessa/servizio are now assigned by the BO instead of the segnalatore. Backend: new test_segnalazioni_assegnazione.py passes 15/15. The older test_segnalazioni.py and test_segnalazioni_export_stats.py were updated to the new flow (create, then assign) and the combined suite passes 53/53. Frontend: segnalatore create dialog (no commessa/servizio, shows 'Da assegnare' badge); BO list, 'Da assegnare' filter, detail with assegnazione-form and esito-blocked-msg; assign Fastweb+TLS (toast, detail updates, esito-form appears); reassign (pre-filled, save disabled until changed); KO esito; row shows 'Fastweb · TLS'; sidebar badge counter goes 1 to 0; upload on create and download of a document on an unassigned segnalazione (real Aruba Drive, tiny file). All passed.

minor.issue: Does not check is_active on the commessa/servizio, so an inactive servizio can be assigned via the API (the UI options already filter them out).
Reassignment after an esito keeps the esito, and the assignment change is not recorded in any history (only assegnato_by is overwritten). Consider an assegnazione_history entry for auditability.

design_issues.screen: BO detail after assigning while the 'Da assegnare' filter is active
issues: The row disappears from the list behind the dialog as soon as it is assigned (expected because of the filter, but it may surprise users).

action_items: Optional: validate is_active for the commessa/servizio in update_assegnazione
critical_code_review_comments: _scope_query for BO roles returns {$or:[{commessa_id:None}, scoped]}. It is ANDed correctly in _filters_query, so the 'none' filter and the stats work. This means every BO of any commessa sees ALL unassigned segnalazioni, which matches the user's choice.
Each document stores its own aruba_commessa_id, so documents uploaded before assignment can still be downloaded after reassignment.
Fallback in _aruba_commessa_for: if no commessa has Aruba enabled it returns ids[0]; the global Aruba setting is then used by _aruba_client. OK.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed segnalazioni were created and then deleted. No passwords changed. NOTE: segnalatore_test had password_change_required=True in the DB (blocking UI login with the 'Cambio Password Richiesto' screen); I set it to False without changing the password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If segnalatore_test shows a password-change screen, set users.password_change_required=False in mongo; do not change the password. Old tests now create, then PUT /assegnazione (as admin). Commessa filter 'Da assegnare' = value 'none'. In the detail dialog, the upload needs detail-files-input followed by detail-files-upload-btn.
